title: For migrations where the instance has a system metadata entry with key = 'i
question: For migrations where the instance has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the migration status and instance VM state combinations whose migration count is more than 75% of the total number of such instances in that VM state, along with the migration count and minimum instance memory (MB). Also include subtotals by migration status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.status AS migration_status,
         i.vm_state AS vm_state,
         i.memory_mb AS memory_mb
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
),
combos AS (
  SELECT migration_status, vm_state,
         COUNT(*) AS migration_count,
         MIN(memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status, vm_state
)
SELECT c.migration_status, c.vm_state, c.migration_count, c.min_memory_mb
FROM combos c
JOIN state_totals t ON t.vm_state = c.vm_state
WHERE c.migration_count > 0.75 * t.total
UNION ALL
SELECT c.migration_status, 'SUBTOTAL', SUM(c.migration_count), MIN(c.min_memory_mb)
FROM combos c
JOIN state_totals t ON t.vm_state = c.vm_state
WHERE c.migration_count > 0.75 * t.total
GROUP BY c.migration_status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GRAND TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', SUM(c.migration_count), MIN(c.min_memory_mb)
FROM combos c
JOIN state_totals t ON t.vm_state = c.vm_state
WHERE c.migration_count > 0.75 * t.total
ORDER BY 1, 2

  SELECT 
    m.status AS migration_status,
    i.vm_state,
    COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count,
    MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state
),
vm_state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    vm_state,
    SUM(migration_count) AS total_instances_in_vm_state
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
)

  CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE b.migration_status END AS migration_status,
  b.vm_state,
  SUM(b.migration_count) AS migration_count,
  MIN(b.min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb
FROM base b
JOIN vm_state_totals vst ON b.vm_state = vst.vm_state
WHERE b.migration_count > 0.75 * vst.total_instances_in_vm_state
GROUP BY b.migration_status, b.vm_state WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.migration_status) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  b.migration_status,
  b.vm_state
